rules: Exactly one acceptance case per canonical mechanic ID, M001-M119.
Do not copy or change canonical mechanic status fields when proposing tests.
Every case requires exact function/caller mapping before execution.
Every state-changing case includes a positive outcome, rejection scenario, retry semantics, persistence expectation and cross-system assertion.
Any missing owner API, unavailable local Blueprint dependency or untestable scenario must be reported as blocked, not passed.
Static review, automated test, Unreal build/UHT, PIE, and save/load are separate evidence types.
